summary: Basel Medical Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the appointment of Mr. Neo Chun How Alton as interim Chief Financial Officer, effective June 2, 2026, replacing Ms. Jianing Lu who resigned. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under the 1934 Act. No financial terms, stake, premium, or advisors are mentioned. The change appears to be a routine CFO transition, not a forced or abrupt departure. The filing does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation. The board thanked Ms. Lu for her service. No deal terms apply.
